## Checklist

- [ ] I've signed the [CLA](../CLA.md), or will when the bot asks.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] Every fixture was built by hand with made-up data. None is a saved portal page.
- [ ] No credentials, student IDs, schedules, session URLs, or unredacted screenshots are included.
- [ ] Adapter code only reads the page. It uses none of the banned APIs in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The only manifest change is the host approved on the campus request (or there is no manifest change).
- [ ] I tested this unpacked build on my live portal.
